# Version 4.153.0
> **Skia m153 preview** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.153.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.300/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.153.0 previews the Skia m153 renderer with upstream bug fixes. Linux applications that rely on fontconfig fallback may select a different face after upgrading; use an explicit family, style, or bundled typeface when selection must be deterministic.

## Breaking Changes

- **Linux font fallback may choose a different face** — Skia now tries FcFontMatch before the previous FcFontSort fallback path, which can change text metrics or glyphs. Specify a family and style explicitly, or bundle a typeface, when deterministic selection matters. ([#4826](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4826), [#4927](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4927))

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m153** — Previews the Chrome milestone 153 renderer and includes subsequent upstream m153 bug fixes. ([#4826](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4826), [#4927](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4927))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.300

No HarfBuzzSharp binding changes shipped in this release — it rebuilds the same HarfBuzz as the previous line.

## Preview 1 (September 3, 2026)

Preview 1 opens the 4.153 line with the Skia m153 engine update and its upstream bug fixes.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.152.0...v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6)
